import sys
import heapq

def main():
    import sys
    import heapq
    
    def readints():
        return list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    
    data = readints()
    N = data[0]
    A = data[1:]
    
    # Use a max-heap (invert values to use min-heap as max-heap)
    heap = [-a for a in A]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    
    while len(heap) > 1:
        # Extract the two largest elements
        largest = -heapq.heappop(heap)
        second_largest = -heapq.heappop(heap)
        
        # The largest attacks the second largest
        new_health = largest - second_largest
        
        # Push the result back into the heap
        if new_health > 0:
            heapq.heappush(heap, -new_health)
    
    # The last remaining element is the answer
    print(-heap[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
thought_path_snapshot: Simulate the battle process by always having the monster with the highest remaining health attack the monster with the second-highest remaining health until only one monster remains.
